name: pyxis
title: Pyxis Portfolio Challenge
description: Two pharma companies compete to build the most valuable drug-development portfolio over a fixed horizon.

episodeSteps.description: Framework step cap. The match ends earlier when the engine terminates both players (bankruptcy or horizon).

actTimeout.description: Seconds an agent has to return an action each step.

runTimeout.description: Seconds the whole episode may run (excludes the one-time reset warmup).

agentTimeout.description: Obsolete field kept for backwards compatibility, please use observation.remainingOverageTime.

seed.description: Optional episode seed. Kaggle controls this to run mirrored seed pairs externally. The interpreter reads it, clears it from configuration, and stores the resolved value on env.info['seed'] so it stays out of agent observations but is recorded in the replay.

reward.description: Match outcome for the agent: 1 = win, 0.5 = draw, 0 = loss (bankruptcy-aware, otherwise by net cash flow). None on error/invalid/timeout.

obs.description: Flattened per-agent observation vector from the engine.

actionMask.description: Per-agent action masks from the engine (e.g. investments legality). Continuous bids are unmasked.

agentIndex.description: Seat index of this agent (0 or 1).

kaggleEnvId.description: Internal id linking a built-in agent to the live engine instance. Ignored by isolated submissions.

cash.description: Agent cash at the current step (GBP).

enpv.description: Agent expected net present value at the current step (GBP).

initialized.description: Internal flag marking that the engine has been created for this episode.

action.description: Engine action dict. Missing or null keys default to no-op. Extra keys (upgrade, site_bid, site_priority, pricing, ...) are passed through when the corresponding feature is enabled.

bd_bids.description: Per-slot business-development cash bids in GBP millions (length bd_max_slots).
